pixel: every art pixel is 2x2 screen pixels; draw with image-rendering: pixelated

menu_button.use: Menu button (top left, replaces the web navigation bar in battle): his thin-rimmed dark square with small corner curls, a red gem set into the top rim, three bars.

button_small.use: Small square button (his, above the party frames); 9-slice with a flat centre; the trefoil emblem goes inside.

target_bar.use: Chained plaque for the targeted or hovered enemy (or the boss): 3-slice; each 72-px cap holds his pale spear tip (lozenge, rose stone, lyre of two loops), the flared collar and the channel's pointed end; the centre is one repeating column (any width works). The red fill goes in the window, with its own pointed ends.

target_fill.use: Red fill for the target plaque channel (3-slice, stretch to the HP fraction).

chain_left.use: Chain from the top edge down to the round medallion's left gem.

chain_right.use: Chain from the end circle of the turn row: flat at first, then curving up to the top edge.

chain_sag.use: Chain hanging under the turn row; draw it under the bells so its ends tuck behind their bases.

chain_link.use: The short chain link between the last bell of the turn row and the end circle.

round_medallion.use: Round counter medallion ("RONDA" over the number, no box behind the word); his softly pointed beaded rim with four oval gems in small bezels. The chains hang from its left gem.

init_active.use: Turn row: the acting unit, a gold square frame (portrait in the window).

init_ally.use: Turn row: an ally (round window, his muted steel-blue rim and base).

init_enemy.use: Turn row: an enemy (round window, his muted rose rim and base).

init_end.use: Turn row: the dark hatched circle that closes the round (a little larger than a portrait ring).

minimap_ring.use: Round minimap frame: his pearly near-white band with a thin gold line on each edge, a fine regular gold lace outside it; cardinal gems in pointed lozenge bezels, diagonal gems in gold lozenges set into the lace (green, red at the lower left, as he painted them). The map shows through the round window.

bar_frame.use: Action bar frame: 9-slice. His thin grey-silver rails, the dotted inner line, dark panel; a gold lace cord down both ends and lace mounts around the corner gems (red on top, green below). With CSS repeat, keep (width - 48) and (height - 48) multiples of 8.

gem_red.use: Loose red gem stud in a gold bezel (corners, medallions).

gem_green.use: Loose green gem stud in a gold bezel (corners, medallions).

end_turn_gem.use: His small pink gem inside the panel, about 10 px down and left of the bar's top-right corner gem; a candidate for the end-turn control.

crest_strip.use: Raised crest over the action bar (3-slice; the centre repeats every 2 art pixels): one long trough (his capsule with rounded ends, double rail and dotted line), HP on the left half, chakra on the right; his dense scroll shoulders at both ends. The acting character medallion covers the middle. Its bottom row sits on the bar's top rail.

medallion_active.use: Acting character medallion: the portrait shows through the round window. A calm crown of a few curls, bosses with two dark oval holes, a red gem on top and his pale pearl at the bottom, which rests on the bar's top rail. Sits on the middle of the crest strip.

hp_fill.use: Red HP fill in the crest trough's left half (3-slice; 12 px tall, in the trough window).

chakra_line.use: The thin line through the chakra trough that the gems sit on (3-slice), centred on the gems.

chakra_red.use: Chakra gem (red): his compact rhombus gem, threaded on the chakra line (centre the gem on the line).

chakra_orange.use: Chakra gem (orange): his compact rhombus gem, threaded on the chakra line (centre the gem on the line).

chakra_blue.use: Chakra gem (blue): his compact rhombus gem, threaded on the chakra line (centre the gem on the line).

chakra_empty.use: Spent chakra gem (dark socket), on the chakra line.

move_trough.use: Movement bar trough, his capsule (3-slice); the teal fill goes inside (2 pixels in from each end, 1 from top and bottom).

skill_slot.use: Skill slot frame: his warm gold, a two-step bevel lit at the top left, rounded corners and small corner curls. The window is open: put a dark backing (panel #16120c) and the skill icon (painted later) under the frame.

skill_slot_active.use: Skill slot, selected or hovered: the same frame in bright gold.

skill_tag.use: Number tag over a skill slot: his hexagonal shield (the slot number, cream, in the label font).

item_slot.use: Item slot, greyed (his): double faint outline with rounded corners, dark well; the icon and label are drawn dim.

item_badge.use: His small dim blue count dot on an item slot (the count in the label font, dim blue-white #b4c4d2).

lower_plaque.use: Dark plaque under the action bar (3-slice): his openwork corner brackets (curled tip, long arm, an eye of two dark dots in a pale ring, an X binding; the background shows through) and rounded capsule ends with a silver rail; for the hint line or the combat log.

party_frame.use: Party portrait frame (9-slice): his thin olive-gold double line with small gold flourishes on the corners; portrait window on top, two bar wells below (red HP at 3,29 4 high, green at 3,34 3 high, in art pixels).

party_ch_fill.use: Party frame second bar (his green; chakra), 3-slice.

glyph_placeholder.use: Faint placeholder in an empty skill slot until the owner paints the icons.

glyph_emblem.use: His small gold trefoil for the small button above the party frames.
